boundary: These observations concern only the fixed 17 trained-correct/LLM-disagreement cases under recorded label-set agreement. They do not adjudicate real-world identity, replace labels, alter scores or characterize all LLM errors.

selection.meaning: Trained output agrees with the recorded reference set; validated saved LLM output does not.

cases.observation: The source names Cambridge and Regina; the LLM retains Cambridge and adds Regina, while the reference lists Cambridge only.
The raw target is the annotated Cornell ID. Its evidence quote replaces source U+00A0 before NY with U+0020, failing exact-span validation. See the hashed original model response and case input.
The source names the George Institute, Sydney and Royal Prince Alfred Hospital; the LLM returns all three, while the reference lists the latter two.
NICTA is explicit alongside UNSW. The added Data61 candidate lists NICTA as an acronym; historical attribution and reference scope remain unadjudicated.
The LLM requests review without selecting a target. The source says Software Systems Ltd.; the annotated candidate says Technologies and supplies no alias resolving the difference.
The source names the institute and university. The additional candidate is the corresponding German-named institute in Essen; whether both units require assignment remains unadjudicated.
Both UAB and IFAE appear in the short source. The LLM adds the UAB candidate; the reference records IFAE only. Required attribution units remain unresolved.
SUBATECH, IN2P3 and CNRS appear alongside Nantes. The LLM retains Nantes and adds those registry records; the reference lists Nantes alone.
University of Tokyo is explicitly named after IPMU. The LLM retains IPMU and adds the university; the reference records the institute only.
CNRS appears in associated-with wording. The LLM adds it to Paris Observatory; whether that relation belongs in the affiliation output is unresolved.
The LLM requests review without selecting a target. The source gives University of Louvain and Heverlee; the annotated candidate gives Universite Catholique de Louvain and Louvain-la-Neuve.
The LLM requests review without selecting a target. The source specifies Maragheh University of Medical Sciences; the annotated University of Maragheh candidate supplies no medical-sciences alias.
CONICET appears explicitly with IByME. The LLM retains IByME and adds the CONICET candidate; required attribution levels remain unresolved.
The source names Ohio State University and Wexner Medical Center. The LLM returns both records; the reference lists the medical center only.
Chinese Academy of Sciences appears with Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden. The LLM retains the garden and adds the Academy; reference scope remains unadjudicated.
University of Karachi appears after the institute and center names. The LLM retains the annotated center and adds the university; required attribution levels remain unresolved.

The LLM infers University of Birmingham from Birmingham Law School against no-ROR reference labels. The supplied candidate fields do not establish that relationship; real-world identity and label completeness were not adjudicated.
